experiment_data.hypothesis: Ablation: perdof CRM v3-norm with DEFAULT max_correction_norm (~1.42, no magnitude control) on LIBERO object benchmark. Tests whether magnitude control is essential on object domain too. If v4-default << v4-perdof (norm=0.1) → magnitude control is universally needed. If v4-default ≈ v4-perdof → spatial failure was anomalous.

spec.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 MUJOCO_GL=egl python -u src/evaluate.py --mode crm_perdof --benchmark object --n_rollouts 10 --seed 42 --K 10 --crm_checkpoint /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/crm_v3_norm/perdof/crm_best.pt --output_file logs/eval_object_perdof_default_norm.json

experiment_data.notes: Killed per Director instruction. 3/10 tasks all 0% SR, no magnitude control (norm≈1.42). Conclusion obvious — magnitude control is essential.
